title: Space War Atari 2600 1978 Game Cartridge with Manual - Tested
descriptionText: The product is a Space War video game cartridge manual for the Atari 2600 console, released in 1978. Published by Atari, this E-Everyone rated game belongs to the war genre and is part of the Space War series. This NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) unit includes the manual and was made in the United States. Perfect for collectors and enthusiasts, this vintage game offers a glimpse into the early days of video gaming history.
